WITH base AS ( SELECT o.ORDER_NO, MAX(p.PAY_NO) AS PAY_NO, COALESCE(MAX(p.PAY_STATUS), MAX(o.ORDER_STATUS), 'PENDING') AS PAY_STATUS FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO GROUP BY o.ORDER_NO ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base b WHERE NVL(b.PAY_STATUS, 'PENDING') IN ('PENDING','READY')

WITH base AS ( SELECT o.ORDER_NO, MAX(p.PAY_NO) AS PAY_NO FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO GROUP BY o.ORDER_NO ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base b WHERE b.PAY_NO IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REFUND r WHERE r.PAY_NO = b.PAY_NO )

WITH base AS ( SELECT o.ORDER_NO, MAX(p.PAY_NO) AS PAY_NO, COALESCE(MAX(p.PAY_STATUS), MAX(o.ORDER_STATUS), 'PENDING') AS PAY_STATUS FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO GROUP BY o.ORDER_NO ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base b WHERE b.PAY_STATUS = 'PAID' AND NOT ( b.PAY_NO IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM REFUND r WHERE r.PAY_NO = b.PAY_NO) )
